blocks.title: Opening your mouth wide!
blocks.body: When you go to the doctor, they say 'Say Aaaah!'. That's the sound of the Aa ki Matra!

blocks.question: What does Aa ki Matra look like?
blocks.explanation: It looks like a straight line standing next to the letter!

blocks.title: Aa Ki Matra ( ा )
blocks.body:
When you add ' ा ' to a letter, it makes the 'Aa' sound.
क + ा = का (Kaa)

blocks.title: Stretch it!
blocks.body: Whenever you see ' ा ', stretch your mouth and the sound!

blocks.title: Reading sentences
blocks.body: राम छाता ला। (Ram, bring the umbrella.)

blocks.question: Which word has Aa ki Matra?
blocks.explanation: कान (Kaan - Ear) has the Aa ki matra!
